g.text: $312,000 over two years, year two conditional
Fixed fee by phase, payable on deliverable acceptance.
Year two — 2027-28, conditional on the gate
Fixed fee per phase, inclusive of travel
Payable on written acceptance of each
Every amount, subtotal, total and payment term on this page is illustrative and would be fixed in a signed statement of work.
The year-two subtotal of $110,000 is released only by the June 2027 board vote; no ongoing retainer is proposed.
